body_html:
@wiobyrne I am planning on doing the same. Currently I have been using @withKnown as my #indieweb engine. I was going to set up a two week WordPress experiment a la @ChisAldrich but then remembered it is finals week, I had to coach three baseball games and go to a communion. Didn't happen.

Still if you want to do a user interview I am collecting interviews before doing think alouds with new users.
